name: Assessment Report
description: Standard deliverable for existing-system, modernization, and audit assessments.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.purpose: One-page summary a sponsor can read in 2 minutes: headline findings, biggest risks, recommended next steps. No raw numbers unless they anchor a decision.

sections.title: Engagement Context & Approach
sections.purpose: Why the engagement, what was in scope, what wasn't, what data sources and methods were used. Sets the frame for the rest of the document.

sections.title: Current State Overview
sections.purpose: Describe the system as observed — architecture style, major components, data flows, operational maturity. Reference the current-state system context diagram.

sections.title: Key Findings
sections.purpose: Top 5–10 findings surfaced by the analysis, grouped by domain. Each finding cites evidence and its severity. Prefer the highest-severity and highest-confidence items.

sections.title: Risk Register
sections.purpose: Tabular summary of risks: title, impact, likelihood, severity, proposed mitigation, suggested owner. Prioritise CRITICAL + HIGH severity.

sections.title: Target State Direction
sections.purpose: Short articulation of where the architecture should go — not a detailed design, just the direction, trade-offs, and why. Reference the target-state architecture diagram.

sections.title: Recommendations & Roadmap
sections.purpose: Prioritised recommendations with rough effort, grouped into near-term / mid-term / long-term. Tie each to the risk(s) it mitigates.

sections.title: Team Composition & Effort Estimate
sections.purpose: Proposed team shape with counts and seniority, effort range, cost range, and the key assumptions behind the numbers. Use the latest estimate.

sections.title: Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.purpose: Assumptions the analysis relied on + the most important unanswered questions. Frame the gaps as prioritised items to close before implementation.

diagrams.title: Current-State System Context
diagrams.description: High-level view of the current system: major components, external systems, and critical data flows.

diagrams.title: Target-State Architecture
diagrams.description: Proposed target architecture showing the shape the system should evolve toward, not a detailed design.
